items.difficulty_reason: Simplicial-object construction lemma (statement 6442-6453, proof 6455-6560): all five face/degeneracy relations are verified through the interchange calculus; relation (1)(a) carries the fully displayed template computation which (1)(b) and (1)(d) invoke with their simplified values stated, (1)(c) and the j = i part of (1)(e) are precisely the two assumptions, and the augmentation identity is checked; no condition is skipped. H2: formal category-calculus proof.
